description: The bar chart titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment" compares the runtime in seconds of different models within a streaming environment. The vertical axis, labeled "Runtime (seconds)," is linear and scales from 0 to 400 seconds, with tick marks at every 50-second interval. The horizontal axis lists the names of the models: "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude." The chart features two sets of bars, each representing a different model type. The "Our Joint Framework" is represented by a single green bar, with a runtime of 77 seconds. The "LLM Models" are represented by four sky blue bars, with runtimes of 190, 365, 172, and 243 seconds for "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude," respectively. Each bar is annotated with its exact runtime value. The chart includes a legend in the upper left corner, distinguishing the two model types by color. The chart is saved as a high-resolution JPEG image named "7-65998.jpg."
